# Frozen SQLite schema

This is native-ce's exact ordered SQLite DDL contract for a fresh database. It is not Native App's PostgreSQL schema. Projections are rebuildable; the event logs named by the DDL remain their authorities. Use `describe_schema` for a live structured view and `query_sql` only through its documented logical catalog.

## Contract identity

- Engine schema version: `50`
- Ordered DDL statements: `292`
- Frozen DDL SHA-256: `86290c2beea87599feb867309ad2bde3a5154f15217114744ed4c765ca2a0c25`

The fingerprint is SHA-256 over the canonical statement sequence joined by `\n;\n`. Generation fails before writing if the compiled sequence and frozen pin disagree.

## Canonical DDL

```sql
CREATE TABLE content_events (
     seq                     INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
     id                      TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     record_id               TEXT NOT NULL,
     type                    TEXT NOT NULL,
     payload                 TEXT,
     actor                   TEXT,
     run_key                 TEXT,
     parent_key              TEXT,
     intent                  TEXT,
     causal_envelope_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (causal_envelope_version = 1),
     causal_status           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (causal_status IN ('complete','import_incomplete','legacy_unknown')),
     created_at              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_content_events_record ON content_events(record_id, seq)
;
CREATE INDEX idx_content_events_run ON content_events(run_key, seq)
;
CREATE TABLE content_event_causal_frontier (
     event_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     parent_event_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(parent_event_id)) > 0),
     PRIMARY KEY (event_id, parent_event_id),
     CHECK (event_id <> parent_event_id)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_content_event_causal_frontier_parent
       ON content_event_causal_frontier(parent_event_id, event_id)
;
CREATE TABLE content_event_causal_cutover (
     singleton             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
     last_legacy_local_seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (last_legacy_local_seq >= 0),
     cutover_at            TEXT NOT NULL,
     from_engine_schema    INTEGER
   )
;
INSERT INTO content_event_causal_cutover
       (singleton,last_legacy_local_seq,cutover_at,from_engine_schema)
       VALUES (1,0,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),NULL)
;
CREATE TABLE policy_events (
     seq        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
     id         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     record_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
     type       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('policy.replaced','policy.inheritance_restored')),
     payload    TEXT,
     actor      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(actor)) > 0),
     reason     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(reason)) > 0),
     created_at TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_policy_events_record ON policy_events(record_id, seq)
;
CREATE TRIGGER policy_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON policy_events
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'policy_events is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER policy_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON policy_events
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'policy_events is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TABLE content_event_sources (
     event_id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES content_events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     origin_database_id  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(origin_database_id)) > 0),
     source_seq          INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (source_seq > 0),
     source_record_id    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(source_record_id)) > 0),
     source_principal    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(source_principal)) > 0),
     source_fingerprint  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_fingerprint) = 64)
   )
;
CREATE TABLE replicated_message_provenance (
     source_event_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES content_event_sources(event_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     content_version      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (content_version IN ('native.message.v1','native.message.v2')),
     operation            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (operation = 'message.created'),
     source_account_token TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(source_account_token)) > 0),
     source_created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
     canonical_payload    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(canonical_payload)),
     payload_digest       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(payload_digest) = 64),
     envelope_id          TEXT,
     envelope_digest      TEXT,
     CHECK ((envelope_id IS NULL AND envelope_digest IS NULL)
         OR (envelope_id IS NOT NULL AND envelope_digest IS NOT NULL
             AND length(trim(envelope_id)) > 0 AND length(envelope_digest) = 64))
   )
;
CREATE TABLE destination_message_ingest (
     message_id        TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     source_event_id   TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES replicated_message_provenance(source_event_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     relay_state       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (relay_state IN ('queued','collected','acknowledged')),
     ingest_state      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (ingest_state IN ('applied','quarantined_kind')),
     received_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
     sender_state      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (sender_state IN ('known_person','binding_only','principal_only')),
     sender_record_id  TEXT REFERENCES records(id),
     display_hint      TEXT,
     CHECK ((sender_state = 'principal_only' AND sender_record_id IS NULL)
         OR (sender_state <> 'principal_only' AND sender_record_id IS NOT NULL))
   )
;
CREATE TABLE replicated_message_references (
     source_message_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     reference_id        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(reference_id)) > 0),
     relationship        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (relationship IN ('thread','reply_to','supersedes','mention','relates_to')),
     target_origin_db_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(target_origin_db_id)) > 0),
     target_record_id    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(target_record_id)) > 0),
     target_binding      TEXT,
     display_label       TEXT,
     source_digest       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_digest) = 64),
     resolved_local_id   TEXT REFERENCES records(id),
     PRIMARY KEY (source_message_id, reference_id)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_replicated_message_references_resolution
       ON replicated_message_references(resolved_local_id, source_message_id)
;
CREATE TABLE records (
     id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     type          TEXT NOT NULL,
     kind          TEXT,
     name          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
     body          TEXT,

     home_id     TEXT REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,

     lifecycle     TEXT,
     owner_id      TEXT REFERENCES records(id),

     -- Engine-owned work coordination projection. The account is the occupancy
     -- sentinel; a live claim always has its event timestamp, while run context
     -- is optional. Public record reads deliberately omit all three columns.
     claimed_by_account TEXT,
     claimed_run_key    TEXT,
     claimed_at         TEXT,
     -- Derived nearest explicit replacement-policy boundary. Nullable at the
     -- SQLite layer so a v8 file can add/backfill it in place; engine open and
     -- conformance reject every committed NULL or non-explicit anchor.
     policy_anchor_id TEXT REFERENCES records(id),
     -- NON-NULL per spine decision 2e5ed3e Am.2 §3 (dedup/merge fails-wrong
     -- without it). DEFAULT 'enduring' keeps creation cheap — reconciled with
     -- the candidate DDL 9561d43 during the build (option (a)).
     persistence   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'enduring' CHECK (persistence IN ('enduring','occurrent')),
     maturity      TEXT,

     summary          TEXT,
     last_activity_at TEXT,

     created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
     updated_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
     deleted_at    TEXT,

     CHECK (type IN ('Document','Program','WorkItem','Outcome','Entity','Collection','Resolution','Conversation','Message','Annotation')),
     CHECK ((claimed_by_account IS NULL AND claimed_run_key IS NULL AND claimed_at IS NULL)
         OR (claimed_by_account IS NOT NULL AND claimed_at IS NOT NULL))
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_records_type      ON records(type)       WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
;
CREATE INDEX idx_records_kind      ON records(type, kind) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
;
CREATE INDEX idx_records_home      ON records(home_id)  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
;
CREATE INDEX idx_records_owner     ON records(owner_id)
;
CREATE INDEX idx_records_policy_anchor ON records(policy_anchor_id)
;
CREATE INDEX idx_records_lifecycle ON records(lifecycle)  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
;
CREATE INDEX idx_records_open_claims
       ON records(claimed_by_account, claimed_at DESC)
       WHERE claimed_by_account IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
;
CREATE INDEX idx_records_maturity  ON records(maturity)   WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
;
CREATE TABLE record_policies (
     record_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     created_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
   )
;
CREATE TABLE policy_entries (
     policy_anchor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES record_policies(record_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     subject_kind     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_kind IN ('members','account')),
     subject_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
     effect           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'allow' CHECK (effect = 'allow'),
     capability       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (capability IN ('view','edit','manage')),
     CHECK ((subject_kind = 'members' AND subject_id = 'native:members' AND capability IN ('view','edit'))
         OR (subject_kind = 'account' AND length(subject_id) > 0)),
     PRIMARY KEY (policy_anchor_id, subject_kind, subject_id, effect)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_policy_entries_subject
       ON policy_entries(subject_kind, subject_id, policy_anchor_id, capability)
;
CREATE TABLE links (
     id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     source_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     target_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     relationship  TEXT NOT NULL,
     note          TEXT,
     created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
     UNIQUE (source_id, target_id, relationship)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_links_source ON links(source_id, relationship)
;
CREATE INDEX idx_links_target ON links(target_id, relationship)
;
CREATE TABLE message_audience_state (
     message_id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     status              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending_local','declared','legacy_unknown')),
     declaration_event_seq INTEGER,
     updated_at          TEXT NOT NULL,
     CHECK ((status = 'declared' AND declaration_event_seq IS NOT NULL)
         OR (status <> 'declared' AND declaration_event_seq IS NULL))
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_message_audience_state_status
       ON message_audience_state(status, message_id)
;
CREATE TABLE message_audiences (
     message_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     principal_id   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(principal_id)) > 0),
     source         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('sender','addressed_to','share')),
     grant_id       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(grant_id)) > 0),
     event_seq      INTEGER NOT NULL,
     created_at     TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (message_id, principal_id, source, grant_id)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_message_audiences_principal
       ON message_audiences(principal_id, message_id)
;
CREATE TABLE message_origin_state (
     message_id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     status                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('declared','legacy_unknown')),
     origin_type           TEXT CHECK (origin_type IN ('collection','direct')),
     collection_id         TEXT CHECK (collection_id IS NULL OR length(trim(collection_id)) > 0),
     direct_set_digest     TEXT CHECK (direct_set_digest IS NULL OR length(direct_set_digest) = 64),
     participant_count     INTEGER,
     declaration_event_seq INTEGER,
     updated_at            TEXT NOT NULL,
     CHECK ((status = 'legacy_unknown'
             AND origin_type IS NULL AND collection_id IS NULL
             AND direct_set_digest IS NULL AND participant_count IS NULL
             AND declaration_event_seq IS NULL)
         OR (status = 'declared' AND declaration_event_seq IS NOT NULL
             AND ((origin_type = 'collection' AND collection_id IS NOT NULL
                   AND direct_set_digest IS NULL AND participant_count = 0)
               OR (origin_type = 'direct' AND collection_id IS NULL
                   AND direct_set_digest IS NOT NULL AND participant_count > 0))))
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_message_origin_collection
       ON message_origin_state(origin_type, collection_id, message_id)
;
CREATE INDEX idx_message_origin_direct
       ON message_origin_state(origin_type, direct_set_digest, participant_count, message_id)
;
CREATE TABLE message_origin_principals (
     message_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES message_origin_state(message_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     principal_id  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(principal_id)) > 0),
     event_seq     INTEGER NOT NULL,
     created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (message_id, principal_id)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_message_origin_principals_principal
       ON message_origin_principals(principal_id, message_id)
;
CREATE TABLE message_conversations (
     message_id       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     conversation_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     event_seq        INTEGER NOT NULL,
     classified_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (message_id, conversation_id)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_message_conversations_conversation
       ON message_conversations(conversation_id, message_id)
;
CREATE INDEX idx_message_conversations_message
       ON message_conversations(message_id, conversation_id)
;
CREATE TABLE awareness_events (
     seq                    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
     id                     TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     idempotency_key        TEXT NOT NULL,
     intent_sha256          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(intent_sha256) = 64),
     schema_version         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (schema_version = 1),
     subject_account_id     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(subject_account_id)) > 0),
     -- Every lane names exactly one subject, and which column carries it is
     -- what the lane means. The four Message lanes key on `message_id`; the
     -- destination lane keys on `destination_id`, the Collection on the
     -- member's personal rail. The paired CHECKs below make the coupling a
     -- schema fact rather than a convention, so a destination event can never
     -- be written as a nameless Message event or vice versa.
     message_id             TEXT CHECK (message_id IS NULL OR length(trim(message_id)) > 0),
     destination_id         TEXT CHECK (destination_id IS NULL OR length(trim(destination_id)) > 0),
     lane                   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (lane IN ('human','agent','preference','routing','destination')),
     action                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(action)) > 0),
     authenticated_actor    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(authenticated_actor)) > 0),
     executor_kind          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (executor_kind IN ('human_attested','agent','system')),
     executor_ref           TEXT,
     delegation_ref         TEXT,
     expected_version       INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (expected_version >= 0),
     reason_code            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(reason_code)) > 0),
     interaction_nonce      TEXT,
     payload                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload)),
     created_at             TEXT NOT NULL,
     UNIQUE (subject_account_id, idempotency_key),
     UNIQUE (subject_account_id, message_id, interaction_nonce),
     UNIQUE (subject_account_id, destination_id, interaction_nonce),
     CHECK ((lane = 'destination') = (destination_id IS NOT NULL)),
     CHECK ((lane = 'destination') = (message_id IS NULL))
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_awareness_events_subject_seq
       ON awareness_events(subject_account_id, seq)
;
CREATE INDEX idx_awareness_events_message
       ON awareness_events(message_id, subject_account_id, seq)
;
CREATE INDEX idx_awareness_events_destination
       ON awareness_events(destination_id, subject_account_id, seq)
;
CREATE TRIGGER awareness_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON awareness_events
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'awareness_events is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER awareness_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON awareness_events
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'awareness_events is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TABLE awareness_command_intents (
     subject_account_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(subject_account_id)) > 0),
     idempotency_key    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(idempotency_key)) > 0),
     intent_sha256      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(intent_sha256) = 64),
     created_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (subject_account_id, idempotency_key)
   )
;
CREATE TRIGGER awareness_command_intents_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON awareness_command_intents
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'awareness_command_intents is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER awareness_command_intents_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON awareness_command_intents
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'awareness_command_intents is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TABLE human_message_awareness (

     first_presented_at TEXT,

CREATE INDEX idx_human_message_awareness_subject_stage

CREATE TABLE agent_message_dispositions (

   )

CREATE INDEX idx_agent_message_dispositions_subject_state

CREATE TABLE awareness_event_evidence (

     PRIMARY KEY (event_id, evidence_record_id, evidence_role)

CREATE INDEX idx_awareness_evidence_record

CREATE TABLE message_inbox_routing (

     message_id         TEXT NOT NULL,
     obligation_state   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (obligation_state IN ('none','open','satisfied','withdrawn')),
     executor_route     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (executor_route IN ('unassigned','human','agent','joint','closed')),
     reason_code        TEXT NOT NULL,
     policy_version     TEXT,

   )

CREATE INDEX idx_message_inbox_routing_subject_state

;
CREATE TABLE message_preferences (

     snoozed_until      TEXT,

   )

CREATE INDEX idx_message_preferences_due

CREATE TABLE message_mentions (

CREATE TABLE notification_candidate_events (

     priority           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (priority IN ('routine','urgent')),
     not_before         TEXT,
     redaction_class    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (redaction_class IN ('metadata_only','minimal_context')),
     evaluator_kind     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (evaluator_kind IN ('portable_default','recipient_policy','intervention_policy')),
     policy_version     TEXT NOT NULL,

   )

;
CREATE TRIGGER notification_candidate_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON notification_candidate_events
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'notification_candidate_events is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER notification_candidate_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON notification_candidate_events
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'notification_candidate_events is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TABLE notification_candidates (

     candidate_key      TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,

     priority           TEXT NOT NULL,
     not_before         TEXT,

    )

;
CREATE TABLE artifact_source_attestations (
     attestation_event_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     artifact_id           TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     source_event_id       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     source_sha256         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_sha256) = 64),
     descriptor            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(descriptor)),
     attestation_sha256    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(attestation_sha256) = 64),
     event_seq             INTEGER NOT NULL,
     created_at            TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_artifact_source_attestations_artifact ON artifact_source_attestations(artifact_id, event_seq)
;
CREATE TABLE artifact_inputs (
     artifact_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     port_name      TEXT NOT NULL,
     collection_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     artifact_source_attestation_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     artifact_source_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     artifact_source_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(artifact_source_sha256) = 64),
     event_seq      INTEGER NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (artifact_id, port_name)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_artifact_inputs_collection ON artifact_inputs(collection_id, artifact_id)
;
CREATE TABLE artifact_module_grants (
     artifact_id                  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     subject_kind                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_kind IN ('module_release','artifact_source')),
     subject_record_id            TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     subject_event_id             TEXT NOT NULL,
     source_sha256                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_sha256) = 64),
     artifact_source_attestation_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     artifact_source_event_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
     artifact_source_sha256       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(artifact_source_sha256) = 64),
     capability                   TEXT NOT NULL,
     scope_sha256                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(scope_sha256) = 64),
     scope                        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(scope)),
     event_seq                    INTEGER NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (artifact_id, subject_kind, subject_record_id, subject_event_id, capability, scope_sha256)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_artifact_module_grants_artifact ON artifact_module_grants(artifact_id, subject_kind, subject_event_id)
;
CREATE TABLE annotation_targets (
     annotation_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     target_record_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     source_slot       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_slot IN ('body','blob')),
     source_event_seq  INTEGER,
     blob_id           TEXT REFERENCES blobs(id),
     source_sha256     TEXT NOT NULL,
     selectors         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(selectors) AND json_type(selectors) = 'array'),
     purpose           TEXT,
     created_at        TEXT NOT NULL,
     updated_at        TEXT NOT NULL,
     CHECK ((source_slot = 'body' AND source_event_seq IS NOT NULL AND blob_id IS NULL)
         OR (source_slot = 'blob' AND source_event_seq IS NULL AND blob_id IS NOT NULL))
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_annotation_targets_target ON annotation_targets(target_record_id)
;
CREATE TABLE facet_values (
     id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     record_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     key         TEXT NOT NULL,
     value       TEXT,
     value_num   REAL GENERATED ALWAYS AS (
       CASE WHEN json_valid(value) THEN
         CASE WHEN json_type(value) IN ('integer','real')
              THEN CAST(value AS REAL) END
       END
     ) VIRTUAL,
     vocab_ref   TEXT,
     created_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
     UNIQUE (record_id, key)
    )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_facet_values_key ON facet_values(key, value)
;
CREATE INDEX idx_facet_values_num ON facet_values(key, value_num) WHERE value_num IS NOT NULL
;
CREATE TABLE facet_observations (
     id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     record_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     key         TEXT NOT NULL,
     value       TEXT,
     op          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (op IN ('set','unset')),
     vocab_ref   TEXT,
     as_of       TEXT NOT NULL,
     observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
     event_seq   INTEGER NOT NULL,
     UNIQUE (record_id, key, as_of)
    )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_facet_observations_series ON facet_observations(record_id, key, as_of)
;
CREATE INDEX idx_facet_observations_key ON facet_observations(key, as_of)
;
CREATE TABLE bindings (
     record_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     system        TEXT NOT NULL,
     identifier    TEXT NOT NULL,
     is_canonical  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_canonical IN (0, 1)),
     url           TEXT,
     etag          TEXT,
     last_seen_at  TEXT,
     PRIMARY KEY (record_id, system, identifier)
   )
;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_bindings_external_identity ON bindings(system, identifier)
;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_bindings_one_canonical_per_system
       ON bindings(record_id, system) WHERE is_canonical = 1
;
CREATE TABLE binding_systems (
     system                    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     normalizer                TEXT NOT NULL,
     compatible_type           TEXT,
     compatible_kind           TEXT,
     visibility                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (visibility IN ('public','internal','reserved')),
     add_policy               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (add_policy IN ('record_manage','internal','forbidden')),
     remove_policy            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (remove_policy IN ('record_manage','internal','forbidden')),
     canonicalize_policy      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (canonicalize_policy IN ('record_manage','internal','forbidden')),
     transfer_policy          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (transfer_policy IN ('record_manage','internal','forbidden')),
     reconciliation_rule      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reconciliation_rule IN ('binding_only','none')),
     stub_allowed              INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (stub_allowed IN (0, 1)),
     authoritative_provenance  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (authoritative_provenance IN (0, 1)),
     required_durable          INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (required_durable IN (0, 1))
   )
;
INSERT INTO binding_systems
       (system, normalizer, compatible_type, compatible_kind, visibility,
        add_policy, remove_policy, canonicalize_policy, transfer_policy, reconciliation_rule,
        stub_allowed, authoritative_provenance, required_durable)
       VALUES
       ('native-principal', 'native-principal-v1', 'Entity', 'person', 'public',
        'record_manage', 'record_manage', 'record_manage', 'record_manage', 'binding_only', 1, 1, 1),
       ('email', 'email-v1', 'Entity', 'person', 'reserved',
        'internal', 'internal', 'internal', 'internal', 'binding_only', 0, 1, 0),
       ('account', 'account-v1', 'Entity', 'person', 'reserved',
        'internal', 'internal', 'internal', 'internal', 'binding_only', 0, 1, 1),
       ('native-record', 'native-record-v1', NULL, NULL, 'public',
        'record_manage', 'record_manage', 'record_manage', 'record_manage', 'binding_only', 1, 1, 1)
;
CREATE TABLE binding_audit (
     seq               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
     id                TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     action            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('add','remove','canonicalize','transfer')),
     system            TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES binding_systems(system),
     identifier        TEXT NOT NULL,
     old_record_id     TEXT,
     new_record_id     TEXT,
     old_canonical     INTEGER CHECK (old_canonical IN (0, 1)),
     new_canonical     INTEGER CHECK (new_canonical IN (0, 1)),
     actor             TEXT NOT NULL,
     reason            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(reason)) > 0),
     run_key           TEXT,
     parent_key        TEXT,
     intent            TEXT,
     created_at        TEXT NOT NULL,
     CHECK ((action = 'add' AND old_record_id IS NULL AND new_record_id IS NOT NULL
                              AND old_canonical IS NULL AND new_canonical IS NOT NULL)
         OR (action = 'remove' AND old_record_id IS NOT NULL AND new_record_id IS NULL
                                 AND old_canonical IS NOT NULL AND new_canonical IS NULL)
         OR (action = 'transfer' AND old_record_id IS NOT NULL AND new_record_id IS NOT NULL
                                   AND old_record_id <> new_record_id
                                   AND old_canonical = new_canonical)
         OR (action = 'canonicalize' AND old_record_id = new_record_id
                                       AND old_canonical <> new_canonical))
    )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_binding_audit_identity ON binding_audit(system, identifier, seq)
;
CREATE TRIGGER binding_audit_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON binding_audit
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'binding_audit is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER binding_audit_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON binding_audit
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'binding_audit is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TABLE external_observations (
     id                       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     record_id                TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     source_system            TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES binding_systems(system),
     source_identifier        TEXT NOT NULL,
     quality                  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (quality IN ('reported','fetched')),
     as_of                    TEXT,
     observed_at              TEXT NOT NULL,
     actor                    TEXT NOT NULL,
     reason                   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(reason)) > 0),
     run_key                  TEXT,
     parent_key               TEXT,
     intent                   TEXT,
     materialization_policy   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (materialization_policy IN ('identity_only','snapshot')),
     display_name             TEXT,
     source_revision          TEXT CHECK (source_revision IS NULL OR length(trim(source_revision)) > 0),
     source_digest            TEXT CHECK (source_digest IS NULL OR length(trim(source_digest)) > 0),
     freshness                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (freshness IN ('unknown','fresh','stale')),
     retention_state          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (retention_state IN ('none','captured','retained')),
     source_availability      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_availability IN ('unknown','available','unavailable')),
     refresh_outcome          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (refresh_outcome IN ('not_attempted','succeeded','failed')),
     retained_from_observation_id TEXT REFERENCES external_observations(id),
     provenance_attachment_id TEXT REFERENCES records(id),
     derived_render_id        TEXT REFERENCES records(id),
     CHECK ((materialization_policy = 'identity_only' AND retention_state = 'none'
              AND retained_from_observation_id IS NULL AND provenance_attachment_id IS NULL
              AND derived_render_id IS NULL)
         OR (materialization_policy = 'snapshot' AND retention_state = 'captured'
              AND retained_from_observation_id IS NULL AND provenance_attachment_id IS NOT NULL)
         OR (materialization_policy = 'snapshot' AND retention_state = 'retained'
              AND retained_from_observation_id IS NOT NULL AND provenance_attachment_id IS NOT NULL
              AND freshness = 'stale' AND refresh_outcome = 'failed')),
     CHECK (quality = 'fetched' OR derived_render_id IS NULL)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_external_observations_record ON external_observations(record_id, observed_at)
;
CREATE TABLE database_identity (
     singleton    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
     origin_db_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (
       length(origin_db_id) = 36 AND substr(origin_db_id, 1, 4) = 'ndb_'
       AND substr(origin_db_id, 5) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
     ),
     created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE TABLE database_identity_audit (
     seq              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
     id               TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     action           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('mint','rekey')),
     old_origin_db_id TEXT,
     new_origin_db_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     actor            TEXT NOT NULL,
     reason           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(reason)) > 0),
     run_key          TEXT,
     parent_key       TEXT,
     intent           TEXT,
     created_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
     CHECK ((action = 'mint' AND old_origin_db_id IS NULL)
         OR (action = 'rekey' AND old_origin_db_id IS NOT NULL AND old_origin_db_id <> new_origin_db_id))
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_database_identity_audit_new ON database_identity_audit(new_origin_db_id, seq)
;
CREATE TABLE blobs (
     id                TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     bytes             BLOB,
     mime              TEXT,
     size_bytes        INTEGER,
     sha256            TEXT,
     original_filename TEXT,
     storage_tier      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inline' CHECK (storage_tier IN ('inline','external')),
     external_ref      TEXT,
     created_at        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_blobs_sha ON blobs(sha256)
;
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE records_fts USING fts5 (
     name, body,
     content='records', content_rowid='rowid',
     tokenize='porter unicode61'
   )
;
CREATE TRIGGER records_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON records BEGIN
     INSERT INTO records_fts(rowid, name, body) VALUES (new.rowid, new.name, new.body);
   END
;
CREATE TRIGGER records_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON records BEGIN
     INSERT INTO records_fts(records_fts, rowid, name, body) VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.name, old.body);
   END
;
CREATE TRIGGER records_fts_au AFTER UPDATE ON records BEGIN
     INSERT INTO records_fts(records_fts, rowid, name, body) VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.name, old.body);
     INSERT INTO records_fts(rowid, name, body)               VALUES (new.rowid, new.name, new.body);
   END
;
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE records_name_idx USING fts5 (
     name,
     content='records', content_rowid='rowid',
     tokenize='unicode61'
   )
;
CREATE TRIGGER records_name_idx_ai AFTER INSERT ON records BEGIN
     INSERT INTO records_name_idx(rowid, name) VALUES (new.rowid, new.name);
   END
;
CREATE TRIGGER records_name_idx_ad AFTER DELETE ON records BEGIN
     INSERT INTO records_name_idx(records_name_idx, rowid, name) VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.name);
   END
;
CREATE TRIGGER records_name_idx_au AFTER UPDATE ON records BEGIN
     INSERT INTO records_name_idx(records_name_idx, rowid, name) VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.name);
     INSERT INTO records_name_idx(rowid, name)                   VALUES (new.rowid, new.name);
   END
;

CREATE TABLE vocabularies (

   )

CREATE TABLE vocabulary_values (
     id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     vocabulary_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vocabularies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

   )

CREATE INDEX idx_read_log_calls_run     ON read_log_calls(run_key, seq)

CREATE INDEX idx_read_log_calls_started ON read_log_calls(started_at)

     call_seq     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES read_log_calls(seq) ON DELETE CASCADE,

     result_rank  INTEGER,
     PRIMARY KEY (call_seq, record_id, interaction)
   )

CREATE INDEX idx_read_log_touches_record ON read_log_touches(record_id, call_seq)
;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS authorization_revision (
     id     INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
     epoch  INTEGER NOT NULL
   )
;
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO authorization_revision (id, epoch) VALUES (1, 0)
;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS authorization_revision_records_insert AFTER INSERT ON records
       BEGIN UPDATE authorization_revision SET epoch = epoch + 1 WHERE id = 1; END
;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS authorization_revision_records_delete AFTER DELETE ON records
       BEGIN UPDATE authorization_revision SET epoch = epoch + 1 WHERE id = 1; END
;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS authorization_revision_records_update
       AFTER UPDATE OF owner_id, policy_anchor_id, deleted_at, type, kind ON records
       WHEN OLD.owner_id IS NOT NEW.owner_id
         OR OLD.policy_anchor_id IS NOT NEW.policy_anchor_id
         OR OLD.deleted_at IS NOT NEW.deleted_at
         OR OLD.type IS NOT NEW.type
         OR OLD.kind IS NOT NEW.kind
       BEGIN UPDATE authorization_revision SET epoch = epoch + 1 WHERE id = 1; END
;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS authorization_revision_record_policies_insert AFTER INSERT ON record_policies
       BEGIN UPDATE authorization_revision SET epoch = epoch + 1 WHERE id = 1; END
;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS authorization_revision_record_policies_delete AFTER DELETE ON record_policies
       BEGIN UPDATE authorization_revision SET epoch = epoch + 1 WHERE id = 1; END
;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS authorization_revision_record_policies_update AFTER UPDATE ON record_policies
       WHEN OLD.record_id IS NOT NEW.record_id
         OR OLD.created_at IS NOT NEW.created_at
       BEGIN UPDATE authorization_revision SET epoch = epoch + 1 WHERE id = 1; END
;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS authorization_revision_policy_entries_insert AFTER INSERT ON policy_entries
       BEGIN UPDATE authorization_revision SET epoch = epoch + 1 WHERE id = 1; END
;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS authorization_revision_policy_entries_delete AFTER DELETE ON policy_entries
       BEGIN UPDATE authorization_revision SET epoch = epoch + 1 WHERE id = 1; END
;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS authorization_revision_policy_entries_update AFTER UPDATE ON policy_entries
       WHEN OLD.policy_anchor_id IS NOT NEW.policy_anchor_id
         OR OLD.subject_kind IS NOT NEW.subject_kind
         OR OLD.subject_id IS NOT NEW.subject_id
         OR OLD.effect IS NOT NEW.effect
         OR OLD.capability IS NOT NEW.capability
       BEGIN UPDATE authorization_revision SET epoch = epoch + 1 WHERE id = 1; END
;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS authorization_revision_bindings_insert AFTER INSERT ON bindings
       WHEN NEW.system = 'account'
       BEGIN UPDATE authorization_revision SET epoch = epoch + 1 WHERE id = 1; END
;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS authorization_revision_bindings_delete AFTER DELETE ON bindings
       WHEN OLD.system = 'account'
       BEGIN UPDATE authorization_revision SET epoch = epoch + 1 WHERE id = 1; END
;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS authorization_revision_bindings_update AFTER UPDATE ON bindings
       WHEN (OLD.system = 'account' OR NEW.system = 'account')
        AND (OLD.record_id IS NOT NEW.record_id
          OR OLD.system IS NOT NEW.system
          OR OLD.identifier IS NOT NEW.identifier
          OR OLD.is_canonical IS NOT NEW.is_canonical
          OR OLD.url IS NOT NEW.url
          OR OLD.etag IS NOT NEW.etag
          OR OLD.last_seen_at IS NOT NEW.last_seen_at)
       BEGIN UPDATE authorization_revision SET epoch = epoch + 1 WHERE id = 1; END
;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS authorization_revision_links_insert AFTER INSERT ON links
       WHEN NEW.relationship = 'part_of'
       BEGIN UPDATE authorization_revision SET epoch = epoch + 1 WHERE id = 1; END
;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS authorization_revision_links_delete AFTER DELETE ON links
       WHEN OLD.relationship = 'part_of'
       BEGIN UPDATE authorization_revision SET epoch = epoch + 1 WHERE id = 1; END
;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS authorization_revision_links_update AFTER UPDATE ON links
       WHEN (OLD.relationship = 'part_of' OR NEW.relationship = 'part_of')
        AND (OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id
          OR OLD.source_id IS NOT NEW.source_id
          OR OLD.target_id IS NOT NEW.target_id
          OR OLD.relationship IS NOT NEW.relationship
          OR OLD.note IS NOT NEW.note
          OR OLD.created_at IS NOT NEW.created_at)
       BEGIN UPDATE authorization_revision SET epoch = epoch + 1 WHERE id = 1; END
;
CREATE TABLE control_events (
     seq             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
     id              TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(trim(idempotency_key)) > 0),
     type            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(type)) > 0),
     schema_version  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version > 0),
     aggregate_kind  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(aggregate_kind)) > 0),
     aggregate_id    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(aggregate_id)) > 0),
     actor           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(actor)) > 0),
     run_key         TEXT,
     reason          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(reason)) > 0),
     payload         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload) AND json_type(payload) = 'object'),
     created_at      TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_control_events_aggregate ON control_events(aggregate_kind, aggregate_id, seq)
;
CREATE TRIGGER control_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON control_events
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'control_events is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER control_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON control_events
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'control_events is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TABLE agent_runs (
     activity_id        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     run_key            TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(trim(run_key)) > 0),
     account_id         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(account_id)) > 0),
     started_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
     ended_at           TEXT,
     start_event_id     TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES control_events(id),
     start_event_seq    INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES control_events(seq),
     close_event_id     TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES control_events(id),
     close_event_seq    INTEGER UNIQUE REFERENCES control_events(seq),
     CHECK ((ended_at IS NULL AND close_event_id IS NULL AND close_event_seq IS NULL)
         OR (ended_at IS NOT NULL AND close_event_id IS NOT NULL AND close_event_seq IS NOT NULL))
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_account_started
       ON agent_runs(account_id, started_at, activity_id)
;
CREATE TABLE member_contexts (
     account_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     person_record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     root_record_id   TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES records(id),
     created_at       TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE TABLE instruction_bindings (
     id               TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     scope_kind       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope_kind IN ('database','account')),
     scope_id         TEXT NOT NULL,
     source_record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     position         INTEGER NOT NULL,
     enabled          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (enabled IN (0,1)),
     created_by       TEXT NOT NULL,
     created_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
     updated_at       TEXT NOT NULL,

     UNIQUE (scope_kind, scope_id, source_record_id)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_instruction_bindings_source ON instruction_bindings(source_record_id)

CREATE TABLE onboarding_programmes (

     trigger_key TEXT NOT NULL,

     enabled     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (enabled IN (0,1)),

     legacy_baseline_before TEXT,
     created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
     updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE TABLE onboarding_programme_sources (
     programme_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES onboarding_programmes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     source_record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     source_role      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_role IN ('guidance','completion_criteria')),
```
