     PRIMARY KEY (programme_id, source_record_id),
     UNIQUE (programme_id, position)
   )
;
CREATE TABLE member_obligations (
     account_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
     programme_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES onboarding_programmes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     generation      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation > 0),
     state           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending','completed','declined')),
     created_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
     updated_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
     updated_by      TEXT,
     updated_run_key TEXT,
     reason          TEXT,
     PRIMARY KEY (account_id, programme_id, generation)
   )
;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_member_obligations_one_pending
       ON member_obligations(account_id, programme_id) WHERE state = 'pending'
;
CREATE TABLE member_obligation_progress (
     account_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
     programme_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
     generation      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation > 0),
     phase           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (phase IN ('anchor_established','route_selected','artifact_previewed','artifact_written','value_delivered','deferred')),
     evidence        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(evidence) AND json_type(evidence) = 'object' AND length(CAST(evidence AS BLOB)) <= 4096),
     resume_after    TEXT,
     artifact_id     TEXT REFERENCES records(id),
     selected_route_id TEXT CHECK (selected_route_id IN ('practical_workflow','comparative_evaluation','conceptual_explanation')),
     updated_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
     updated_by      TEXT NOT NULL,
     updated_run_key TEXT,
     reason          TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (account_id, programme_id, generation),
     FOREIGN KEY (account_id, programme_id, generation)
       REFERENCES member_obligations(account_id, programme_id, generation) ON DELETE CASCADE
   )
;
CREATE TABLE seeded_instruction_sources (
     source_record_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES records(id),
     template_key        TEXT NOT NULL,
     template_version    INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (template_version > 0),
     last_applied_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
     last_applied_at     TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE TABLE control_event_applications (
     event_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     event_seq  INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (event_seq > 0),
     applied_at TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_events (
     seq             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
     id              TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(trim(idempotency_key)) > 0),
     type            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('derivation.series.created','derivation.revision.completed','derivation.attempt.failed','derivation.target.bound','derivation.target.detached','derivation.target.published','derivation.artifact_role.assigned','derivation.artifact_role.retired','derivation.revision.confirmed','derivation.confirmation.retracted')),
     schema_version  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version > 0),
     aggregate_kind  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (aggregate_kind IN ('derivation_series','derivation_revision','derivation_attempt','derivation_binding','derivation_publication','derivation_artifact_role','derivation_confirmation')),
     aggregate_id    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(aggregate_id)) > 0),
     actor           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(actor)) > 0),
     run_key         TEXT,
     reason          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(reason)) > 0),
     payload         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload) AND json_type(payload) = 'object'),
     created_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
     CHECK ((type = 'derivation.series.created' AND aggregate_kind = 'derivation_series')
         OR (type = 'derivation.revision.completed' AND aggregate_kind = 'derivation_revision')
         OR (type = 'derivation.attempt.failed' AND aggregate_kind = 'derivation_attempt')
         OR (type IN ('derivation.target.bound','derivation.target.detached') AND aggregate_kind = 'derivation_binding')
         OR (type = 'derivation.target.published' AND aggregate_kind = 'derivation_publication')
         OR (type IN ('derivation.artifact_role.assigned','derivation.artifact_role.retired') AND aggregate_kind = 'derivation_artifact_role')
         OR (type IN ('derivation.revision.confirmed','derivation.confirmation.retracted') AND aggregate_kind = 'derivation_confirmation'))
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_derivation_events_aggregate ON derivation_events(aggregate_kind, aggregate_id, seq)
;
CREATE TRIGGER derivation_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON derivation_events
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'derivation_events is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER derivation_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON derivation_events
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'derivation_events is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_series (
     id                 TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     series_key         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(trim(series_key)) > 0),
     definition         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(definition) AND json_type(definition) = 'object'),
     definition_sha256  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(definition_sha256) = 64),
     created_event_id   TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     created_event_seq  INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (created_event_seq > 0),
     created_at         TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_revisions (
     id                              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     series_id                       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES derivation_series(id),
     predecessor_revision_id         TEXT REFERENCES derivation_revisions(id),
     definition_sha256               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(definition_sha256) = 64),
     canonical_request               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(canonical_request) AND json_type(canonical_request) = 'object'),
     canonical_request_sha256        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(canonical_request_sha256) = 64),
     request_identity_sha256         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(request_identity_sha256) = 64),
     recipe_revision                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(recipe_revision) AND json_type(recipe_revision) = 'object'),
     recipe_revision_ref_sha256      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(recipe_revision_ref_sha256) = 64),
     effective_source_boundary       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(effective_source_boundary) AND json_type(effective_source_boundary) = 'object'),
     effective_source_boundary_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(effective_source_boundary_sha256) = 64),
     input_manifest                  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(input_manifest) AND json_type(input_manifest) = 'object'),
     input_manifest_sha256           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(input_manifest_sha256) = 64),
     output_ref                      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(output_ref) AND json_type(output_ref) = 'object'),
     output_ref_sha256               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(output_ref_sha256) = 64),
     completion_metadata             TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(completion_metadata) AND json_type(completion_metadata) = 'object'),
     completion_metadata_sha256      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(completion_metadata_sha256) = 64),
     completed_event_id              TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     completed_event_seq             INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (completed_event_seq > 0),
     completed_at                    TEXT NOT NULL,
     UNIQUE (series_id, id),
     UNIQUE (predecessor_revision_id),
     FOREIGN KEY (series_id, predecessor_revision_id)
       REFERENCES derivation_revisions(series_id, id)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_derivation_revisions_series ON derivation_revisions(series_id, completed_event_seq)
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_revision_inputs (
     revision_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES derivation_revisions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     ordinal      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
     input_role   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (input_role IN ('source','context')),
     input_kind   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (input_kind IN ('content_event','record_body','blob','versioned')),
     portable_id  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(portable_id)) > 0),
     sha256       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(sha256) = 64),
     metadata     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(metadata) AND json_type(metadata) = 'object'),
     PRIMARY KEY (revision_id, ordinal),
     UNIQUE (revision_id, input_role, input_kind, portable_id)
   )
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_attempts (
     id                              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     series_id                       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES derivation_series(id),
     canonical_request               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(canonical_request) AND json_type(canonical_request) = 'object'),
     canonical_request_sha256        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(canonical_request_sha256) = 64),
     recipe_revision                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(recipe_revision) AND json_type(recipe_revision) = 'object'),
     recipe_revision_ref_sha256      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(recipe_revision_ref_sha256) = 64),
     effective_source_boundary       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(effective_source_boundary) AND json_type(effective_source_boundary) = 'object'),
     effective_source_boundary_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(effective_source_boundary_sha256) = 64),
     request_identity_sha256         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(request_identity_sha256) = 64),
     coordination_request_key_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(coordination_request_key_sha256) = 64 AND coordination_request_key_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
     attempt_ordinal                 INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempt_ordinal > 0),
     retryable                       INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (retryable IN (0,1)),
     executor_descriptor             TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(executor_descriptor) AND json_type(executor_descriptor) = 'object'),
     executor_descriptor_sha256      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(executor_descriptor_sha256) = 64),
     failure_code                    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(failure_code)) > 0),
     failure_metadata                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(failure_metadata) AND json_type(failure_metadata) = 'object'),
     failure_metadata_sha256         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(failure_metadata_sha256) = 64),
     failed_event_id                 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     failed_event_seq                INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (failed_event_seq > 0),
     failed_at                       TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_derivation_attempts_series ON derivation_attempts(series_id, failed_event_seq)
;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_derivation_attempts_request_ordinal ON derivation_attempts(coordination_request_key_sha256, attempt_ordinal)
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_target_bindings (
     binding_id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     series_id          TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES derivation_series(id),
     target_kind        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_kind = 'record'),
     target_record_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
     target_slot        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_slot = 'body'),
     generation         INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation > 0),
     bound_event_id     TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     bound_event_seq    INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (bound_event_seq > 0),
     bound_at           TEXT NOT NULL,
     detached_event_id  TEXT UNIQUE,
     detached_event_seq INTEGER UNIQUE,
     detached_at        TEXT,
     UNIQUE (target_kind,target_record_id,target_slot,generation),
     CHECK ((detached_event_id IS NULL AND detached_event_seq IS NULL AND detached_at IS NULL)
         OR (detached_event_id IS NOT NULL AND detached_event_seq IS NOT NULL AND detached_at IS NOT NULL))
   )
;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_derivation_target_bindings_active
       ON derivation_target_bindings(target_kind,target_record_id,target_slot)
       WHERE detached_event_id IS NULL
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_target_publications (
     publication_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     binding_id         TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES derivation_target_bindings(binding_id),
     generation         INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation > 0),
     target_version     INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (target_version > 0),
     revision_id        TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES derivation_revisions(id),
     output_event_id    TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     output_sha256      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(output_sha256) = 64),
     published_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     published_event_seq INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (published_event_seq > 0),
     published_at       TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_derivation_target_publications_binding
       ON derivation_target_publications(binding_id,generation,published_event_seq)
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_selected_publications (
     target_kind      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_kind = 'record'),
     target_record_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     target_slot      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_slot = 'body'),
     publication_id   TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES derivation_target_publications(publication_id),
     binding_id       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES derivation_target_bindings(binding_id),
     generation       INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation > 0),
     target_version   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (target_version > 0),
     revision_id      TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES derivation_revisions(id),
     output_event_id  TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     output_sha256    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(output_sha256) = 64),
     selected_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (target_kind,target_record_id,target_slot)
   )
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_target_heads (
     target_kind            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_kind = 'record'),
     target_record_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
     target_slot            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_slot = 'body'),
     generation             INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation >= 0),
     target_version         INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (target_version >= 0),
     active_binding_id      TEXT REFERENCES derivation_target_bindings(binding_id),
     selected_publication_id TEXT REFERENCES derivation_target_publications(publication_id),
     PRIMARY KEY (target_kind,target_record_id,target_slot)
   )
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_event_applications (
     event_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     event_seq  INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (event_seq > 0),
     applied_at TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_artifact_role_assignments (
     assignment_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     target_kind        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_kind='record'),
     target_record_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
     target_slot        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_slot='body'),
     role               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(role)) > 0),
     assigned_event_id  TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     assigned_event_seq INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (assigned_event_seq > 0),
     assigned_at        TEXT NOT NULL,
     UNIQUE(target_kind,target_record_id,target_slot,role,assignment_id)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_derivation_artifact_roles_role
       ON derivation_artifact_role_assignments(role,target_record_id,assigned_event_seq)
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_artifact_role_retirements (
     retirement_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     assignment_id    TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES derivation_artifact_role_assignments(assignment_id),
     retired_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     retired_event_seq INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (retired_event_seq > 0),
     retired_at       TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_artifact_role_heads (
     target_kind         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_kind='record'),
     target_record_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
     target_slot         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_slot='body'),
     role                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(role)) > 0),
     active_assignment_id TEXT REFERENCES derivation_artifact_role_assignments(assignment_id),
     head_event_id       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     head_event_seq      INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (head_event_seq > 0),
     PRIMARY KEY(target_kind,target_record_id,target_slot,role)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_derivation_artifact_role_heads_active_role
       ON derivation_artifact_role_heads(role,target_record_id,target_slot,active_assignment_id)
       WHERE active_assignment_id IS NOT NULL
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_revision_confirmations (
     confirmation_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     assignment_id         TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES derivation_artifact_role_assignments(assignment_id),
     series_id             TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES derivation_series(id),
     revision_id           TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES derivation_revisions(id),
     publication_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES derivation_target_publications(publication_id),
     binding_id            TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES derivation_target_bindings(binding_id),
     generation            INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation > 0),
     target_version        INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (target_version > 0),
     input_manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(input_manifest_sha256)=64),
     output_sha256         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(output_sha256)=64),
     predecessor_head_event_id TEXT,
     confirmed_event_id    TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     confirmed_event_seq   INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (confirmed_event_seq > 0),
     confirmed_at          TEXT NOT NULL,
     confirmed_by          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(confirmed_by)) > 0),
     UNIQUE(assignment_id,confirmation_id)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_derivation_confirmations_assignment
       ON derivation_revision_confirmations(assignment_id,confirmed_event_seq)
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_confirmation_retractions (
     retraction_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     confirmation_id    TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES derivation_revision_confirmations(confirmation_id),
     retracted_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     retracted_event_seq INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (retracted_event_seq > 0),
     retracted_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
     retracted_by       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(retracted_by)) > 0)
   )
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_confirmation_heads (
     assignment_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES derivation_artifact_role_assignments(assignment_id),
     confirmation_id TEXT REFERENCES derivation_revision_confirmations(confirmation_id),
     head_event_id   TEXT,
     head_event_seq  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (head_event_seq > 0)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_derivation_confirmation_heads_current
       ON derivation_confirmation_heads(confirmation_id,head_event_seq)
;
CREATE TABLE recipe_releases (
     publication_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     program_id            TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     source_event_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
     source_sha256         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_sha256) = 64),
     descriptor_sha256     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(descriptor_sha256) = 64),
     descriptor            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(descriptor) AND json_type(descriptor) = 'object'),
     status                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('published','deprecated','withdrawn')),
     local_event_seq       INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (local_event_seq > 0),
     status_event_seq      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (status_event_seq > 0),
     published_at          TEXT NOT NULL,
     UNIQUE (program_id, source_event_id)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_recipe_releases_program ON recipe_releases(program_id, local_event_seq)
;
CREATE TABLE recipe_release_input_classes (
     publication_event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipe_releases(publication_event_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     ordinal              INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
     input_class          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (input_class IN ('blob','content_event','record_body','versioned')),
     PRIMARY KEY (publication_event_id, ordinal),
     UNIQUE (publication_event_id, input_class)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_recipe_release_input_class ON recipe_release_input_classes(input_class, publication_event_id)
;
CREATE TABLE derivation_requests (
     id                         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     request_key_sha256         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(request_key_sha256) = 64 AND request_key_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
     request_identity           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(request_identity) AND json_type(request_identity) = 'object'),
     series_id                  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES derivation_series(id),
     definition_sha256          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(definition_sha256) = 64 AND definition_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
     canonical_request          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(canonical_request) AND json_type(canonical_request) = 'object'),
     recipe_revision            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(recipe_revision) AND json_type(recipe_revision) = 'object'),
     effective_source_boundary  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(effective_source_boundary) AND json_type(effective_source_boundary) = 'object'),
     target_basis               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(target_basis) AND json_type(target_basis) = 'object'),
     budget                     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(budget) AND json_type(budget) = 'object'),
     audience_sha256            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(audience_sha256) = 64 AND audience_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
     requested_by               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(requested_by)) > 0),
     requested_run_key          TEXT,
     state                      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (state IN ('pending','running','succeeded','failed')),
     lease_owner                TEXT,
     lease_run_key              TEXT,
     lease_generation           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (lease_generation >= 0),
     lease_expires_at           TEXT,
     attempt_count              INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempt_count >= 0 AND attempt_count = lease_generation),
     retryable                  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (retryable IN (0,1)),
     next_attempt_at            TEXT,
     failure_code               TEXT,
     failure_metadata           TEXT CHECK (failure_metadata IS NULL OR (json_valid(failure_metadata) AND json_type(failure_metadata) = 'object')),
     result_revision_id         TEXT REFERENCES derivation_revisions(id),
     created_at                 TEXT NOT NULL,
     updated_at                 TEXT NOT NULL,
     CHECK ((state = 'pending' AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_run_key IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL AND retryable = 0 AND next_attempt_at IS NULL AND failure_code IS NULL AND failure_metadata IS NULL AND result_revision_id IS NULL)
         OR (state = 'running' AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(lease_owner)) > 0 AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_generation > 0 AND retryable = 0 AND next_attempt_at IS NULL AND failure_code IS NULL AND failure_metadata IS NULL AND result_revision_id IS NULL)
         OR (state = 'succeeded' AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_run_key IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL AND retryable = 0 AND next_attempt_at IS NULL AND failure_code IS NULL AND failure_metadata IS NULL AND result_revision_id IS NOT NULL)
         OR (state = 'failed' AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_run_key IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL AND failure_code IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(failure_code)) > 0 AND failure_metadata IS NOT NULL AND result_revision_id IS NULL AND (retryable = 1 OR next_attempt_at IS NULL))),
     CHECK (lease_run_key IS NULL OR lease_owner IS NOT NULL)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_derivation_requests_work
       ON derivation_requests(state,retryable,next_attempt_at,lease_expires_at,updated_at)
;
CREATE TABLE storage_portability_policy (
     singleton               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
     policy_revision         INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (policy_revision > 0),
     enforcement             TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (enforcement IN ('off','strict')),
     source_profile_id       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(source_profile_id)) > 0),
     source_profile_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (source_profile_revision > 0),
     source_mode             TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_mode IN ('embedded','network','sync')),
     targets                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(targets) AND json_type(targets)='array'),
     revision_floors         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(revision_floors) AND json_type(revision_floors)='array'),
     allow_conversions       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(allow_conversions) AND json_type(allow_conversions)='array'),
     catalog_sha256          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(catalog_sha256) = 64 AND catalog_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
     updated_at              TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE TABLE semantic_units (
     unit_id                    TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     authority_bearer_record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     creation_event_id          TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES content_events(id),
     creation_event_seq         INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (creation_event_seq > 0),
     label                      TEXT,
     created_at                 TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_semantic_units_bearer
       ON semantic_units(authority_bearer_record_id, unit_id)
;
CREATE TABLE unit_revisions (
     revision_event_id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES content_events(id),
     unit_id                    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES semantic_units(unit_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     revision_seq               INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (revision_seq > 0),
     based_on_revision_event_id TEXT REFERENCES unit_revisions(revision_event_id),
     content_sha256             TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(content_sha256) = 64),
     content_media_type         TEXT NOT NULL,
     encoding_version           INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (encoding_version > 0),
     rationale                  TEXT,
     actor                      TEXT,
     created_at                 TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_unit_revisions_unit
       ON unit_revisions(unit_id, revision_seq)
;
CREATE TABLE unit_heads (
     unit_id           TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES semantic_units(unit_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     revision_event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES unit_revisions(revision_event_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     PRIMARY KEY (unit_id, revision_event_id)
   )
;
CREATE TABLE occurrences (
     occurrence_id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     binding_event_id          TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES content_events(id),
     binding_event_seq         INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (binding_event_seq > 0),
     unit_id                   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES semantic_units(unit_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     unit_revision_event_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES unit_revisions(revision_event_id),
     artefact_id               TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     artefact_revision_event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id),
     artefact_revision_seq     INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (artefact_revision_seq > 0),
     artefact_sha256           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(artefact_sha256) = 64),
     selectors                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(selectors) AND json_type(selectors) = 'array'),
     selectors_sha256          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(selectors_sha256) = 64),
     expression_role           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (expression_role IN ('canonical','paraphrase','summary','quotation')),
     actor                     TEXT,
     created_at                TEXT NOT NULL,
     UNIQUE (unit_revision_event_id, artefact_revision_event_id, selectors_sha256, expression_role)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_occurrences_unit
       ON occurrences(unit_id, unit_revision_event_id, occurrence_id)
;
CREATE INDEX idx_occurrences_artefact
       ON occurrences(artefact_id, artefact_revision_seq, occurrence_id)
;
CREATE TABLE freshness_command_results (
     scope_record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
     operation       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (operation IN ('promote_idea','bind_occurrence','revise_unit')),
     intent_sha256   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(intent_sha256) = 64),
     result_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES content_events(id),
     event_seq       INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (event_seq > 0),
     authorization_revision_observed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (authorization_revision_observed >= 0),
     created_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (scope_record_id, idempotency_key)
   )
;
CREATE TABLE freshness_runtime_command_results (
     scope_record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
     operation       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (operation IN ('commit_durable_output','reconcile_dependency','supersede_unit','audit_dependency')),
     intent_sha256   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(intent_sha256) = 64),
     result_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES content_events(id),
     event_seq       INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (event_seq > 0),
     authorization_revision_observed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (authorization_revision_observed >= 0),
     created_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (scope_record_id, idempotency_key)
   )
;
CREATE TABLE dependencies (
     dependency_id                  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     receipt_id                     TEXT NOT NULL,
     declaration_event_id           TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id),
     declaration_event_seq          INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (declaration_event_seq > 0),
     consumer_record_id             TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     consumer_revision_event_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id),
     consumer_revision              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(consumer_revision)),
     source_record_id               TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     source_revision_event_id       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id),
     source_revision                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(source_revision)),
     semantic_role                  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(semantic_role)) > 0),
     affected_conclusion            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(affected_conclusion)),
     rationale                      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(rationale)) > 0),
     reconsideration_trigger        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(reconsideration_trigger)) > 0),
     confidence                     REAL CHECK (confidence >= 0.0 AND confidence <= 1.0),
     actor                          TEXT NOT NULL,
     created_at                     TEXT NOT NULL,
     UNIQUE (receipt_id, dependency_id)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_dependencies_source
       ON dependencies(source_record_id, source_revision_event_id, dependency_id)
;
CREATE INDEX idx_dependencies_receipt ON dependencies(receipt_id, dependency_id)
;
CREATE TABLE dependency_assessments (
     assessment_id                    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     assessment_event_id              TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id),
     assessment_event_seq             INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (assessment_event_seq > 0),
     receipt_id                       TEXT NOT NULL,
     dependency_id                    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dependencies(dependency_id),
     compared_source_revision_event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id),
     compared_source_revision         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(compared_source_revision)),
     task_scope                       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(task_scope)) > 0),
     category                         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(category)) > 0),
     outcome                          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('immaterial','remains_valid','material','materially_uncertain','contradicted','unable_to_assess')),
     could_materially_change          INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (could_materially_change IN (0,1)),
     rationale                        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(rationale)) > 0),
     actor                            TEXT NOT NULL,
     created_at                       TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_dependency_assessments_dependency
       ON dependency_assessments(dependency_id, assessment_event_seq)
;
CREATE TABLE receipts (
     receipt_id                       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     receipt_event_id                 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES content_events(id),
     receipt_event_seq                INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (receipt_event_seq > 0),
     consumer_record_id               TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     output_revision_event_id         TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id),
     output_revision                  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(output_revision)),
     context_request                  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(context_request)),
     resolution_policy               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(resolution_policy)),
     requested_source_record_ids      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(requested_source_record_ids)),
     selected_sources                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(selected_sources)),
     history_high_water               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(history_high_water)),
     withheld_context                 INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (withheld_context IN (0,1)),
     execution                       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (execution IN ('continued','stopped')),
     disclosure                      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (disclosure IN ('silent','explain_on_inspection','surface_now')),
     actor                           TEXT NOT NULL,
     created_at                      TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_consumer ON receipts(consumer_record_id, receipt_event_seq)
;
CREATE TABLE receipt_provenance (
     receipt_id               TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts(receipt_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     ordinal                  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
     source_record_id         TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     source_revision_event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id),
     source_revision          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(source_revision)),
     reason                   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(reason)) > 0),
     PRIMARY KEY (receipt_id, ordinal)
   )
;
CREATE TABLE receipt_comparisons (
     receipt_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts(receipt_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     ordinal           INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
     dependency_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dependencies(dependency_id),
     pinned_source_revision_event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id),
     pinned_source_revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(pinned_source_revision)),
     selected_source_revision_event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id),
     selected_source_revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(selected_source_revision)),
     PRIMARY KEY (receipt_id, ordinal),
     UNIQUE (receipt_id, dependency_id, selected_source_revision_event_id)
   )
;
CREATE TABLE receipt_uncertainty_lineage (
     receipt_id                  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts(receipt_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     ordinal                     INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
     uncertainty_id              TEXT NOT NULL,
     dependency_id               TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dependencies(dependency_id),
     inherited_from_receipt_id   TEXT,
     lineage                     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(lineage)),
     detail                      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(detail)) > 0),
     PRIMARY KEY (receipt_id, ordinal),
     UNIQUE (receipt_id, uncertainty_id)
   )
;
CREATE TABLE reconciliations (
     reconciliation_id                 TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     reconciliation_event_id           TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id),
     reconciliation_event_seq          INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (reconciliation_event_seq > 0),
     resolving_receipt_id               TEXT REFERENCES receipts(receipt_id),
     resolving_output_revision_event_id TEXT REFERENCES content_events(id),
     dependency_id                     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dependencies(dependency_id),
     consumer_revision_event_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id),
     pinned_source_revision_event_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id),
     assessed_source_revision_event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id),
     assessed_source_revision          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(assessed_source_revision)),
     task_scope                         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(task_scope)) > 0),
     affected_conclusion                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(affected_conclusion)),
     outcome                           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('immaterial','remains_valid','material','materially_uncertain','contradicted','unable_to_assess')),
     rationale                         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(rationale)) > 0),
     actor                             TEXT NOT NULL,
     created_at                        TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_reconciliations_target
       ON reconciliations(dependency_id, assessed_source_revision_event_id, reconciliation_event_seq)
;
CREATE TABLE unit_supersessions (
     supersession_event_id      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id),
     supersession_event_seq     INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (supersession_event_seq > 0),
     predecessor_unit_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES semantic_units(unit_id),
     ordinal                    INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
     successor_unit_id          TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES semantic_units(unit_id),
     successor_revision_event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES unit_revisions(revision_event_id),
     successor_revision         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(successor_revision)),
     rationale                  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(rationale)) > 0),
     actor                      TEXT NOT NULL,
     created_at                 TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (supersession_event_id, ordinal),
     UNIQUE (predecessor_unit_id, successor_unit_id, successor_revision_event_id)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_unit_supersessions_predecessor
       ON unit_supersessions(predecessor_unit_id, supersession_event_seq, ordinal)
;
CREATE TABLE dependency_audits (
     audit_event_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES content_events(id),
     audit_event_seq      INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (audit_event_seq > 0),
     receipt_id           TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES receipts(receipt_id),
     declared_dependency_id TEXT REFERENCES dependencies(dependency_id),
     observed_dependency  TEXT CHECK (observed_dependency IS NULL OR json_valid(observed_dependency)),
     outcome              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('confirmed','missing','overdeclared','underdeclared')),
     rationale            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(rationale)) > 0),
     actor                TEXT NOT NULL,
     created_at           TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE TABLE provenance_interaction_receipts (
     id                  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     schema_version      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version = 1),
     principal           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(principal)) > 0),
     scope_digest        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(scope_digest) = 64),
     nonce               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(nonce)) > 0),
     verifier            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(verifier)) > 0),
     verified_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
     evidence_digest     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(evidence_digest) = 64),
     sealed_evidence_ref TEXT,
     retention_class     TEXT,
     UNIQUE (verifier, nonce)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_provenance_interaction_principal
       ON provenance_interaction_receipts(principal, verified_at, id)
;
CREATE TRIGGER provenance_interaction_receipts_no_update
       BEFORE UPDATE ON provenance_interaction_receipts
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provenance_interaction_receipts is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER provenance_interaction_receipts_no_delete
       BEFORE DELETE ON provenance_interaction_receipts
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provenance_interaction_receipts is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TABLE provenance_action_attestations (
     id                      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     schema_version          INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version IN (1,2)),
     principal               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(principal)) > 0),
     executor_kind           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (executor_kind IN ('human','agent','delegated_service','authenticated_principal','local')),
     -- Server-observed transport. A THIRD axis beside principal and executor
     -- kind: weaker than executor_kind and never a substitute for it. Rows
     -- written before a host declared a transport read as 'unknown', which is
     -- the honest absence of an observation, not another transport.
     channel                 TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK (channel IN ('web','mcp','webhook','local','unknown')),
     executor_ref            TEXT,
     delegation_ref          TEXT,
     interaction_receipt_id  TEXT REFERENCES provenance_interaction_receipts(id),
     operation               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(operation)) > 0),
     action_commitment       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(action_commitment)),
     action_digest           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(action_digest) = 64),
     output_event_set_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(output_event_set_digest) = 64),
     issuer                  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(issuer)) > 0),
     issuer_origin_database_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
       length(issuer_origin_database_id) = 36
       AND substr(issuer_origin_database_id, 1, 4) = 'ndb_'
       AND substr(issuer_origin_database_id, 5) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
     ),
     issued_at               TEXT NOT NULL,
     command_identity_digest TEXT CHECK (command_identity_digest IS NULL OR length(command_identity_digest) = 64),
     intent_digest           TEXT CHECK (intent_digest IS NULL OR length(intent_digest) = 64)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_provenance_action_principal
       ON provenance_action_attestations(principal, issued_at, id)
;
CREATE INDEX idx_provenance_action_command
       ON provenance_action_attestations(principal, operation, command_identity_digest)
       WHERE command_identity_digest IS NOT NULL
;
CREATE TRIGGER provenance_action_attestations_no_update
       BEFORE UPDATE ON provenance_action_attestations
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provenance_action_attestations is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER provenance_action_attestations_no_delete
       BEFORE DELETE ON provenance_action_attestations
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provenance_action_attestations is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TABLE provenance_local_attestation_authority (
     attestation_id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES provenance_action_attestations(id),
     issuer_origin_database_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     principal                 TEXT NOT NULL,
     operation                 TEXT NOT NULL,
     command_identity_digest   TEXT,
     anchored_at               TEXT NOT NULL
   )
;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_provenance_local_authority_command
       ON provenance_local_attestation_authority(principal, operation, command_identity_digest)
       WHERE command_identity_digest IS NOT NULL
;
CREATE TRIGGER provenance_local_attestation_authority_no_update
       BEFORE UPDATE ON provenance_local_attestation_authority
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provenance_local_attestation_authority is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER provenance_local_attestation_authority_no_delete
       BEFORE DELETE ON provenance_local_attestation_authority
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provenance_local_attestation_authority is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TABLE provenance_action_events (
     action_attestation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES provenance_action_attestations(id),
     ordinal               INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
     output_event_id       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES content_events(id),
     PRIMARY KEY (action_attestation_id, ordinal)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_provenance_action_events_event
       ON provenance_action_events(output_event_id, action_attestation_id)
;
CREATE TRIGGER provenance_action_events_no_update
       BEFORE UPDATE ON provenance_action_events
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provenance_action_events is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER provenance_action_events_no_delete
       BEFORE DELETE ON provenance_action_events
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provenance_action_events is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TABLE provenance_attestation_validity_events (
     id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     attestation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES provenance_action_attestations(id),
     ordinal        INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
     status         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('invalidated','restored')),
     reason         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(reason)) > 0),
     issuer         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(issuer)) > 0),
     issued_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
     UNIQUE (attestation_id, ordinal)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_provenance_validity_attestation
       ON provenance_attestation_validity_events(attestation_id, ordinal)
;
CREATE TRIGGER provenance_attestation_validity_events_no_update
       BEFORE UPDATE ON provenance_attestation_validity_events
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provenance_attestation_validity_events is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER provenance_attestation_validity_events_no_delete
       BEFORE DELETE ON provenance_attestation_validity_events
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provenance_attestation_validity_events is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TABLE attribution_targets (
     annotation_id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     target_record_id       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     target_scope           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_scope IN ('whole_revision','passage')),
     source_event_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_events(id),
     source_body_sha256     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_body_sha256) = 64 AND source_body_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
     selectors              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(selectors) AND json_type(selectors) = 'array'),
     bound_event_id         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES content_events(id),
     bound_event_seq        INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (bound_event_seq > 0),
     bound_at               TEXT NOT NULL,
     CHECK ((target_scope = 'whole_revision' AND json_array_length(selectors) = 0)
         OR (target_scope = 'passage' AND json_array_length(selectors) > 0))
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_attribution_targets_bearer
       ON attribution_targets(target_record_id, bound_event_seq, annotation_id)
;
CREATE TABLE attribution_assertions (
     annotation_id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     contract_version          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (contract_version = 'native.attribution.v1'),
     claimant_principal        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(claimant_principal)) > 0),
     claim_mode               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (claim_mode IN ('declaration','assessment')),
     relation                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (relation IN ('expresses_view','endorses')),
     polarity                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (polarity IN ('affirmed','denied')),
     attributed_subject_kind  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (attributed_subject_kind IN ('person_record','agent_execution')),
     attributed_subject_ref   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(attributed_subject_ref)) > 0),
     asserted_at              TEXT NOT NULL,
     stance_as_of             TEXT NOT NULL,
     confidence               TEXT CHECK (confidence IN ('tentative','plausible','likely','confident')),
     transformation           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (transformation IN ('none','selection','paraphrase','summary','synthesis')),
     rationale                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(rationale)) > 0),
     asserted_event_id        TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES content_events(id),
     asserted_event_seq       INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (asserted_event_seq > 0),
     CHECK ((claim_mode = 'declaration' AND confidence IS NULL)
         OR (claim_mode = 'assessment' AND confidence IS NOT NULL)),
     CHECK (claim_mode != 'declaration'
         OR (attributed_subject_kind = 'person_record' AND transformation = 'none'))
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_attribution_assertions_subject
       ON attribution_assertions(attributed_subject_kind, attributed_subject_ref, stance_as_of, annotation_id)
;
CREATE TABLE attribution_evidence (
     evidence_id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     annotation_id           TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES attribution_assertions(annotation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     role                    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('basis','exact_target_confirmation','counterevidence')),
     action_attestation_id   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(action_attestation_id)) > 0),
     added_event_id          TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES content_events(id),
     event_seq               INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (event_seq > 0),
     added_at                TEXT NOT NULL,
     added_by                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(added_by)) > 0),
     UNIQUE (annotation_id, role, action_attestation_id)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_attribution_evidence_annotation
       ON attribution_evidence(annotation_id, event_seq, evidence_id)
;
CREATE TABLE attribution_retractions (
     retraction_id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     annotation_id          TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES attribution_assertions(annotation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
     reason                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(reason)) > 0),
     retracted_event_id     TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES content_events(id),
     retracted_event_seq    INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (retracted_event_seq > 0),
     retracted_at           TEXT NOT NULL,
     retracted_by           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(retracted_by)) > 0)
    )
;
CREATE TABLE provenance_action_outputs (
     action_attestation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES provenance_action_attestations(id),
     ordinal               INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
     output_domain         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (output_domain IN ('content','relationship')),
     output_event_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (action_attestation_id, ordinal),
     UNIQUE (output_domain, output_event_id)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_provenance_action_outputs_event
       ON provenance_action_outputs(output_domain, output_event_id, action_attestation_id)
;
CREATE TRIGGER provenance_action_outputs_no_update
       BEFORE UPDATE ON provenance_action_outputs
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provenance_action_outputs is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER provenance_action_outputs_no_delete
       BEFORE DELETE ON provenance_action_outputs
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provenance_action_outputs is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TABLE relationship_events (
     seq                       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
     id                        TEXT NOT NULL,
     stream_kind               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (stream_kind IN ('relationship','assertion')),
     stream_id                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(stream_id)) > 0),
     stream_version            INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (stream_version > 0),
     relationship_origin_db_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
       length(relationship_origin_db_id) = 36
       AND substr(relationship_origin_db_id, 1, 4) = 'ndb_'
       AND substr(relationship_origin_db_id, 5) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
     ),
     relationship_id           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(relationship_id)) > 0),
     type                      TEXT NOT NULL,
     payload                   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload) AND json_type(payload) = 'object'),
     actor                     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(actor)) > 0),
     issuer_origin_db_id       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
       length(issuer_origin_db_id) = 36
       AND substr(issuer_origin_db_id, 1, 4) = 'ndb_'
       AND substr(issuer_origin_db_id, 5) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
     ),
     occurred_at               TEXT NOT NULL,
     ingested_at               TEXT NOT NULL,
     UNIQUE (issuer_origin_db_id, id),
     UNIQUE (issuer_origin_db_id, stream_kind, stream_id, stream_version),
     CHECK ((stream_kind = 'relationship' AND type IN (
              'relationship.created.v1','relationship.superseded.v1','relationship.retired.v1'))
         OR (stream_kind = 'assertion' AND type IN (
              'assertion.created.v1','assertion.evidence_added.v1','assertion.retracted.v1',
              'assertion.invalidated.v1','assertion.restored.v1')))
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_relationship_events_stream
       ON relationship_events(issuer_origin_db_id, stream_kind, stream_id, stream_version)
;
CREATE INDEX idx_relationship_events_relationship
       ON relationship_events(relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id, seq)
;
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON relationship_events
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'relationship_events is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON relationship_events
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'relationship_events is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TABLE relationships (
     relationship_origin_db_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     relationship_id           TEXT NOT NULL,
     relationship_revision     INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (relationship_revision = 1),
     relationship_type         TEXT NOT NULL,
     type_definition_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
     canonical_proposition_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(canonical_proposition_key) = 64),
     endpoint_semantics        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (endpoint_semantics IN ('directed','symmetric')),
     identity_qualifiers       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(identity_qualifiers) AND json_type(identity_qualifiers) = 'object'),
     reducer_id                TEXT NOT NULL,
     reducer_version           INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (reducer_version > 0),
     stream_version            INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (stream_version > 0),
     status                    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active','superseded','retired')),
     successor_origin_db_id    TEXT,
     successor_relationship_id TEXT,
     created_event_issuer_origin_db_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     created_event_id          TEXT NOT NULL,
     last_event_issuer_origin_db_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     last_event_id             TEXT NOT NULL,
     occurred_at               TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id),
     UNIQUE (created_event_issuer_origin_db_id, created_event_id),
     UNIQUE (last_event_issuer_origin_db_id, last_event_id),
     FOREIGN KEY (created_event_issuer_origin_db_id, created_event_id)
       REFERENCES relationship_events(issuer_origin_db_id, id),
     FOREIGN KEY (last_event_issuer_origin_db_id, last_event_id)
       REFERENCES relationship_events(issuer_origin_db_id, id),
     CHECK ((status = 'superseded') = (successor_origin_db_id IS NOT NULL AND successor_relationship_id IS NOT NULL))
   )
;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_relationships_live_proposition
       ON relationships(relationship_origin_db_id, type_definition_id, canonical_proposition_key)
       WHERE status = 'active'
;
CREATE TABLE relationship_endpoints (
     relationship_origin_db_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     relationship_id           TEXT NOT NULL,
     ordinal                   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
     role                      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(role)) > 0),
     portable_ref              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(portable_ref)) > 0),
     record_type               TEXT,
     record_kind               TEXT,
     record_id                 TEXT REFERENCES records(id),
     PRIMARY KEY (relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id, ordinal),
     UNIQUE (relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id, role, portable_ref),
     FOREIGN KEY (relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id)
       REFERENCES relationships(relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_relationship_endpoints_record
       ON relationship_endpoints(record_id, relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id)
       WHERE record_id IS NOT NULL
;
CREATE TABLE relationship_assertion_heads (
     issuer_origin_db_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    assertion_id              TEXT NOT NULL,
    relationship_origin_db_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    relationship_id           TEXT NOT NULL,
     relationship_revision     INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (relationship_revision = 1),
     relationship_created_event_issuer_origin_db_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     relationship_created_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     stream_version            INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (stream_version > 0),
     stance                    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (stance IN ('support','contest')),
     semantic_claimant         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(semantic_claimant)) > 0),
     on_behalf_of              TEXT CHECK (on_behalf_of IS NULL OR length(trim(on_behalf_of)) > 0),
     rationale                 TEXT,
     valid_from                TEXT,
     valid_until               TEXT,
     causal_parents            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(causal_parents) AND json_type(causal_parents) = 'array'),
     origin_admission          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(origin_admission) AND json_type(origin_admission) = 'object'),
     authoring_action_attestation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     state                     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('active','retracted','invalidated')),
     created_event_issuer_origin_db_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     created_event_id          TEXT NOT NULL,
     last_event_issuer_origin_db_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     last_event_id             TEXT NOT NULL,
     occurred_at               TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (issuer_origin_db_id, assertion_id),
     UNIQUE (created_event_issuer_origin_db_id, created_event_id),
     UNIQUE (last_event_issuer_origin_db_id, last_event_id),
     FOREIGN KEY (created_event_issuer_origin_db_id, created_event_id)
       REFERENCES relationship_events(issuer_origin_db_id, id),
     FOREIGN KEY (last_event_issuer_origin_db_id, last_event_id)
       REFERENCES relationship_events(issuer_origin_db_id, id),
     FOREIGN KEY (relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id)
       REFERENCES relationships(relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id),
     FOREIGN KEY (relationship_created_event_issuer_origin_db_id, relationship_created_event_id)
       REFERENCES relationship_events(issuer_origin_db_id, id)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_relationship_assertion_heads_relationship
       ON relationship_assertion_heads(relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id, issuer_origin_db_id, assertion_id)
;
CREATE TABLE relationship_local_admissions (
     issuer_origin_db_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
     assertion_id              TEXT NOT NULL,
     local_admission_state     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (local_admission_state IN ('admitted','unadmitted','unresolved')),
     local_admission_class     TEXT,
     type_definition_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
     local_policy_version      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (local_policy_version > 0),
     local_reason              TEXT,
     local_evidence_digest     TEXT CHECK (local_evidence_digest IS NULL OR length(local_evidence_digest) = 64),
     recomputed_at             TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (issuer_origin_db_id, assertion_id),
     FOREIGN KEY (issuer_origin_db_id, assertion_id)
       REFERENCES relationship_assertion_heads(issuer_origin_db_id, assertion_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
   )
;
CREATE TABLE effective_relationships (
     relationship_origin_db_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     relationship_id           TEXT NOT NULL,
     effective_state           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (effective_state IN ('active','inactive','unresolved','retired')),
     epistemic_state           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (epistemic_state IN ('unsupported','supported','contested','incomplete')),
     support_count              INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (support_count >= 0),
     contest_count              INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (contest_count >= 0),
     admission_counts           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(admission_counts) AND json_type(admission_counts) = 'object'),
     reducer_id                 TEXT NOT NULL,
     reducer_version            INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (reducer_version > 0),
     assertion_set_digest       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(assertion_set_digest) = 64),
     knowledge_watermark        TEXT NOT NULL,
     recomputed_at              TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id),
     FOREIGN KEY (relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id)
       REFERENCES relationships(relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
   )
;
CREATE TABLE relationship_endpoint_activity (
     relationship_origin_db_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     relationship_id           TEXT NOT NULL,
     event_issuer_origin_db_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
     event_id                   TEXT NOT NULL,
     endpoint_ordinal           INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (endpoint_ordinal >= 0),
     endpoint_role              TEXT NOT NULL,
     portable_ref               TEXT NOT NULL,
     record_id                  TEXT REFERENCES records(id),
     event_type                 TEXT NOT NULL,
     occurred_at                TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id, event_issuer_origin_db_id, event_id, endpoint_ordinal),
     FOREIGN KEY (event_issuer_origin_db_id, event_id)
       REFERENCES relationship_events(issuer_origin_db_id, id),
     FOREIGN KEY (relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id)
       REFERENCES relationships(relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_relationship_endpoint_activity_record
       ON relationship_endpoint_activity(record_id, occurred_at, relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id)
       WHERE record_id IS NOT NULL
;
CREATE TABLE relationship_legacy_links (
     relationship_origin_db_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     relationship_id           TEXT NOT NULL,
     relationship_token        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(relationship_token)) > 0),
     note                      TEXT,
     created_at                TEXT NOT NULL,
     source_facts              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(source_facts) AND json_type(source_facts)='array'),
     PRIMARY KEY (relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id),
     FOREIGN KEY (relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id)
       REFERENCES relationships(relationship_origin_db_id, relationship_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
   )
;
CREATE TABLE relationship_federation_events (
     issuer_origin_db_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
     event_id                   TEXT NOT NULL,
     fingerprint                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(fingerprint)=64),
     source_batch_origin_db_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
     envelope_id                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(envelope_id))>0),
     authenticated_peer_principal TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(authenticated_peer_principal))>0),
     origin_trust_state         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin_trust_state IN ('direct_origin','relayed')),
     origin_evidence_state      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin_evidence_state IN ('not_applicable','verified','missing','legacy','missing_output')),
     received_at                TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (issuer_origin_db_id,event_id),
     FOREIGN KEY (issuer_origin_db_id,event_id)
       REFERENCES relationship_events(issuer_origin_db_id,id) ON DELETE CASCADE
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_relationship_federation_events_source
       ON relationship_federation_events(source_batch_origin_db_id,received_at,issuer_origin_db_id,event_id)
;
CREATE TABLE relationship_federation_quarantine (
     issuer_origin_db_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
     event_id                   TEXT NOT NULL,
     unit_kind                  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (unit_kind IN ('relationship_stream','assertion_stream')),
     stream_id                  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(stream_id))>0),
     stream_version             INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (stream_version>0),
     relationship_origin_db_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
     relationship_id            TEXT NOT NULL,
     fingerprint                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(fingerprint)=64),
     canonical_event            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(canonical_event) AND json_type(canonical_event)='object'),
     reason                     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('missing_predecessor','missing_relationship')),
     source_batch_origin_db_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
     envelope_id                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(envelope_id))>0),
     authenticated_peer_principal TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(authenticated_peer_principal))>0),
     origin_trust_state         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin_trust_state IN ('direct_origin','relayed')),
     origin_evidence_state      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin_evidence_state IN ('not_applicable','verified','missing','legacy','missing_output')),
     received_at                TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (issuer_origin_db_id,event_id),
     UNIQUE (issuer_origin_db_id,unit_kind,stream_id,stream_version)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_relationship_federation_quarantine_stream
       ON relationship_federation_quarantine(issuer_origin_db_id,unit_kind,stream_id,stream_version)
;
CREATE INDEX idx_relationship_federation_quarantine_relationship
       ON relationship_federation_quarantine(relationship_origin_db_id,relationship_id,unit_kind,stream_version)
;
CREATE TABLE relationship_foreign_action_attestations (
     issuer_origin_db_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
     attestation_id            TEXT NOT NULL,
     schema_version            INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version IN (1,2)),
     principal                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(principal))>0),
     operation                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(operation))>0),
     action_digest             TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(action_digest)=64),
     output_event_set_digest   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(output_event_set_digest)=64),
     issued_at                 TEXT NOT NULL,
     canonical_attestation     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(canonical_attestation) AND json_type(canonical_attestation)='object'),
     fingerprint               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(fingerprint)=64),
     PRIMARY KEY (issuer_origin_db_id,attestation_id)
   )
;
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_foreign_action_attestations_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON relationship_foreign_action_attestations
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'relationship foreign action attestations are append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_foreign_action_attestations_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON relationship_foreign_action_attestations
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'relationship foreign action attestations are append-only'); END
;
CREATE TABLE relationship_foreign_action_outputs (
     issuer_origin_db_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
     attestation_id            TEXT NOT NULL,
     ordinal                   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal>=0),
     output_domain             TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (output_domain IN ('content','relationship')),
     output_event_origin_db_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     output_event_id           TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (issuer_origin_db_id,attestation_id,ordinal),
     UNIQUE (output_domain,output_event_origin_db_id,output_event_id),
     FOREIGN KEY (issuer_origin_db_id,attestation_id)
       REFERENCES relationship_foreign_action_attestations(issuer_origin_db_id,attestation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
   )
;
CREATE INDEX idx_relationship_foreign_action_outputs_event
       ON relationship_foreign_action_outputs(output_domain,output_event_origin_db_id,output_event_id,issuer_origin_db_id,attestation_id)
;
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_foreign_action_outputs_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON relationship_foreign_action_outputs
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'relationship foreign action outputs are append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_foreign_action_outputs_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON relationship_foreign_action_outputs
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'relationship foreign action outputs are append-only'); END
;
CREATE TABLE canvas_objects (
     canvas_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     object_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
     kind          TEXT NOT NULL,
     x             REAL NOT NULL,
     y             REAL NOT NULL,
     w             REAL NOT NULL,
     h             REAL NOT NULL,
     z             TEXT NOT NULL,
     parent_id     TEXT,
     props         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(props)),
     deleted       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (deleted IN (0,1)),
     geometry_seq  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (geometry_seq > 0),
     content_seq   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (content_seq > 0),
     created_seq   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_seq > 0),
     PRIMARY KEY (canvas_id, object_id)
   )
;
CREATE INDEX canvas_objects_live ON canvas_objects(canvas_id, deleted, z)
;
CREATE TABLE canvas_batches (
     canvas_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
     batch_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
     actor         TEXT,
     event_id      TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES content_events(id),
     event_seq     INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (event_seq > 0),
     ops_sha256    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(ops_sha256) = 64),
     origin_kind   TEXT NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (canvas_id, batch_id)
   )
;
CREATE TABLE webhook_endpoints (
     id                 TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     name               TEXT NOT NULL,
     issuer_account_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
     destination_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
     profile            TEXT NOT NULL,
     profile_options    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
     allow_query_token  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (allow_query_token IN (0,1)),
     expected_cadence   TEXT,
     created_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
     revoked_at         TEXT,
     revoked_reason     TEXT
   )
;
CREATE TABLE webhook_credentials (
     id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     endpoint_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES webhook_endpoints(id),
     token_prefix  TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     token_hash    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(token_hash) = 64),
     created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
     expires_at    TEXT,
     revoked_at    TEXT
   )
;
CREATE INDEX webhook_credentials_live ON webhook_credentials(endpoint_id, revoked_at)
;
CREATE TABLE webhook_deliveries (
     seq             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
     id              TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
     endpoint_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES webhook_endpoints(id),
     credential_id   TEXT,
     received_at     TEXT NOT NULL,
     external_id     TEXT,
     payload_digest  TEXT CHECK (payload_digest IS NULL OR length(payload_digest) = 64),
     payload_bytes   INTEGER NOT NULL,
     outcome         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN
       ('accepted','duplicate','duplicate_mismatch','rejected_auth','rejected_size',
        'rejected_media_type','malformed','rejected_profile','rejected_authz','throttled','failed')),
     http_status      INTEGER NOT NULL,
     error_code       TEXT,
     record_id        TEXT,
     event_id         TEXT,
     attestation_id   TEXT
   )
;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX webhook_deliveries_accepted_external
       ON webhook_deliveries(endpoint_id, external_id) WHERE outcome = 'accepted'
;
CREATE INDEX webhook_deliveries_recent ON webhook_deliveries(endpoint_id, seq DESC)
;
CREATE TABLE engine_migration_drills (
     id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     migrated_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
     from_version  INTEGER NOT NULL,
     to_version    INTEGER NOT NULL,
     note          TEXT NOT NULL,
     drill_stage   TEXT
   )
;
CREATE TRIGGER engine_migration_drills_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON engine_migration_drills
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'engine_migration_drills is append-only'); END
;
CREATE TRIGGER engine_migration_drills_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON engine_migration_drills
       BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'engine_migration_drills is append-only'); END
;
PRAGMA user_version = 50;
